New character

Set their look, then turn on the attacks they use.

Drag the photo so the face sits inside the circle. Use the slider, a pinch or the mouse wheel to zoom.

Projectile attack Fires at the other fighter from range
Punch attack Hits the other fighter up close
Kick attack A sweeping leg attack — longer reach than the punch, but a long recovery
Grapple attack Grabs a fighter on direct contact and slams them into the nearest wall

Finisher: when a grab would knock the opponent out, it's slammed into the bottom wall, pinned and punched instead.

Sprawl: when another fighter goes for a grab on this one, it can stuff the grab, tie up, then scramble. Either one can come out of it with a Reattack slam.

Power punch Charges up on a timer, slowing to a crawl, then spins into a haymaker that sends the opponent pinballing off the walls
Rage charge Charges off in a random direction throwing a flurry of quick punches, but takes extra damage while it's happening
Corner watch Retreats to a corner and sits — invincible the whole time — then locks tracking lasers onto the opponent
Weave Slips attacks completely. A critical weave chases the opponent down with a punch combo that ends in a launching blow, then celebrates, taking extra damage while it does

Against another fighter with weave: a critical weave in the middle of their combo is a reversal (a combo of its own) or, sometimes, a flow counter that slips the rest of their combo and answers with one strike. No celebrating after combos in these fights, only after a flow counter.

Wild swing (hooks) Telegraphed sweeping hooks at anyone nearby, with no cooldown. The aim is a guess, so they can whiff on spacing, and the arm hangs across the body after each one
CTE Rejuvenation Every few seconds, forgets some of the damage it's taken and regains health
